title: Archived updater-script reports SUCCESS without checking mount/move/link results
reproduction: Read the full 26-line ZIP member. Trace a nonzero result from either mount call or busybox mv/ln; each result is discarded and line 24 remains unconditional. Standard AOSP RunProgramFn returns failure status instead of aborting on a child command failure. No recovery program or host filesystem mutation was executed.
expected: Do not report a successful hosts-file relocation unless required mounts and both move/link steps succeeded; stop or report failure when a command fails.
observed: Four bare run_program calls at lines 11/13/15/17 have no checks or assert/abort path; line 24 always prints SUCCESS after the statements. A failed link can leave a moved hosts file without the expected /system/etc/hosts link; that outcome was not device-tested.
fix: No change made. Record as an archived-helper defect only; any future authorized repair must check results and avoid claiming success on a failed relocation. No new app feature or migration task is proposed.
